decided_before_results: This file was written before any PENGU, kSHIB, DOGE or kPEPE result was computed. Only sizing data already logged in data/raw/web/tardis/results/newcoins/fetch_log.json is known for these coins: Binance book_ticker raw size on 2025-10-01 (PENGU 42.3 MB, kSHIB 17.1 MB, kPEPE 68.8 MB, DOGE 103.8 MB). No trades were simulated for them.
known_at_writing: The parent test's TRUMP and SPX results WERE known when this addendum was written: pooled train n=329 net +$286.4 PF 1.74; validation n=243 net +$136.4 PF 1.39 (PASS); both coins fail at L=800 ms. See reports/candidates/hllag_newcoins.md. That knowledge could bias the decision to run an addendum; it cannot change the frozen rule, days or bar, which are unchanged.
why: PENGU and kSHIB passed the pre-registered liquidity rule and were cut only by the 1.45 GB download budget; DOGE and kPEPE only by the 60 MB file-size gate. Neither reason depends on results. The parent test covered only 2 coins, so the cross-section is thin. Disk is handled by processing one coin-day at a time and deleting raw files after extraction, with large files read in chunks.

The 60 MB size gate no longer applies to DOGE and kPEPE (stage B). This changes coin selection, not the rule.

reported: per coin, train and validation, with a per-coin pass flag under the same bar (a coin 'passes on its own' only if it meets the bar on both splits)
